description: WRITE: Upload a video to an ad account. Returns {id, title}. Prefer `file_url` (remote URL Meta fetches server-side) — streaming a local file over MCP stdio is awkward and rarely needed when videos live in S3 / Dropbox / a CDN. Local `file_path` is accepted for completeness but may be blocked on Windows / sandboxed MCP hosts.

file_path.description: Local path — only works when Node can read the file

file_url.description: Remote URL Meta fetches (recommended for MCP usage)

name: upload_video
